dataset.title: Shanghai official aggregate + Yangshan public reanalysis v3
dataset.intended_use: Shanghai public-data offline RL training, blind holdout evaluation and port-adapter validation
dataset.license: PRC Ministry of Transport public information; Open-Meteo attribution and upstream model terms; code MIT

reanalysis_processing.alignment: hourly UTC inner alignment on the weather and marine model grids
reanalysis_processing.gap_fill: linear interpolation within the same public reanalysis series; no terminal telemetry substituted

sources.publisher: Ministry of Transport of the People's Republic of China

dataset.warning: This is not Shanghai terminal telemetry. Official throughput remains aggregate, environmental values are reanalysis, terminal operational fields are engineering derivatives, and production dispatch stays prohibited until authorized field mapping, calibration, shadow operation and acceptance.

algorithms.name: SAC
algorithms.description: Maximum-entropy off-policy actor-critic for continuous port setpoints.

algorithms.name: PPO
algorithms.description: Clipped on-policy optimization for stable constrained control.

algorithms.name: TD3
algorithms.description: Twin critics and delayed actor updates for continuous dispatch.

algorithms.name: DQN
algorithms.description: Replay-buffer Q-learning on an explicit finite port-control lattice.

algorithms.name: A2C
algorithms.description: Synchronous advantage actor-critic baseline for low-overhead on-policy optimization.

algorithms.name: TQC
algorithms.description: Distributional off-policy actor-critic with truncated quantile critics.

algorithms.name: QR-DQN
algorithms.description: Distributional value learning for a finite auditable port-control lattice.

algorithms.name: TRPO
algorithms.description: Trust-region policy optimization for conservative on-policy updates.

algorithms.name: Recurrent PPO
algorithms.description: LSTM policy for delayed congestion and equipment-availability effects.

algorithms.name: ARS
algorithms.description: Derivative-free random-search policy baseline for robustness comparison.

algorithms.name: FCFS neutral
algorithms.description: Non-optimizing first-come-first-served comparator with neutral energy and allocation commands.

benchmark_summary.deterministic_controller_exception: MPC requires one fixed-window run because it has no learned stochastic initialization
